messages:
Rahul: KPMG wants a concise deliverable showing KMS rotations + RBAC changes for last 90 days. Deadline EOD Tue.
Tess: I'll gather CloudTrail rotate/update events, git commits for infra/kms, and IAM snapshots. Do they want EKS IRSA mapping?
Auditor_KPMG: Yes — mapping from serviceaccounts to role ARNs and a list of principals with decrypt or GenerateDataKey permissions. Machine-readable CSV preferred. No key material.
Rahul: Plan: (A) CloudTrail events (CreateKey, RotateKey, UpdateKeyPolicy, CreateGrant) CSV; (B) git commit IDs + patch for infra/kms-policies; (C) IAM roles snapshot filtered for kms actions; (D) IRSA mapping CSV; (E) manifest.csv with sha256s and redaction flag.
Tess: Quick CLI examples: 
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2027-02-01T00:00:00Z > ct_rotate_90d.json
git diff prod@2026-12-01 prod@2027-01-15 -- infra/kms-policies/ > kms_policy_patch.diff
kubectl get sa --all-namespaces -o json | jq -r '.items[] | [.metadata.namespace, .metadata.name, .metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"]] | @csv' > irsa_map.csv
Tess: Important: redact personal emails; use internal employee IDs. We'll supply identity_map via secure transfer per auditor request.
Rahul: Note an emergency rotation on 2027-01-20 for key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:444555666:key/emer-2027 triggered by CVE-2027-0001 (ticket SEC-889). Include ticket link and post-rotation smoke test decrypt logs (smoke_20270120.log).
export_bot: evidence_job_1739998000 finished: https://s3.internal.company/evidence/1739998000_compact.tar.gz (sha256: e99a18c428cb38d5f260853678922e03)
Auditor_KPMG: We received the bundle. We'll run validation and may ask for a short narrative per rotation (200-400 chars) that explains trigger, approver, and verification steps.
Tess: I'll add short narratives and the redaction_map.csv. Also include grants.csv with create/delete entries.
Rahul: OK to include full role ARNs?
Auditor_KPMG: Full ARNs are acceptable; substitute human identifiers per redaction rules.
Tess: Uploaded manifest.csv sample row:
artifact_type,source,timestamp,evidence_file,sha256,redacted
cloudtrail,aws,2027-01-20T13:02:11Z,ct_rotate_20270120.json,e99a18c428cb38d5f260853678922e03,true
Rahul: Sending cover email with bundle link and SFTP instructions for identity map. I'll schedule a 30-min walkthrough tomorrow AM if they request.
Auditor_KPMG: Thanks — we'll start review and may ping for an IRSA walkthrough for service "ingest-transformer".
Tess: I'm available 09:00-11:00 PST. Closing thread once auditor confirms receipt. :checkered_flag:
